notes.title: Development Update #2 9/6/24
notes.content:
Hello everyone, it has been about a month since the last dev update and I felt that it was about time I updated you guys on the progress of the game since then. So in the last dev update I highlighted a few features I would be cutting and a few that I would be reworking. One month out, I would like to update you guys on a few of them now that I have experimented a bit.

[b]Combat System Overhaul[/b]
Overhauling the combat system has been a major focus of my work since the last update. On major thing that has changed is that it has shifted more towards a party based combat system.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36159923/5d5ef2d449c932d8ed87017697948a9d377dda67.png[/img]
Unlike the original system where you would only control 1 character and have an AI companion, you now instead can assign up to 4 characters for your party and are able to switch between them. The goal of this change is to offer unique play styles between characters. I have 3 character done at this point which are currently the original characters, but with new sprites and animations, more closer to the Secret of Mana aesthetic. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36159923/da292a41940d54f460185bf460d4a92fc275edcd.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36159923/da292a41940d54f460185bf460d4a92fc275edcd.gif[/img][/url]
[i]Cecilia[/i]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36159923/947b6957396cbda3e7fd585513f48ce9cd7ecbdc.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36159923/947b6957396cbda3e7fd585513f48ce9cd7ecbdc.gif[/img][/url]
[i]Leon[/i]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36159923/4ba835513a3622c09da72592a63a47027176c196.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36159923/4ba835513a3622c09da72592a63a47027176c196.gif[/img][/url]
[i]Risette[/i]
As you can see each of these 3 characters use different weapons and all play a little bit differently with each roughly falling into the traditional party roles of Damage, Tank, and Support. Attacking, dodging or blocking in combat will use stamina which is the yellow bar in the first picture and will regenerate slower while you are playing the character to encourage switching party members while in combat.

Let's briefly talk about the other mechanics that use stamina.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36159923/df353086de21cfbf30c72955efcc3134142feb4b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36159923/be06149733b5de1d69dae86031ca44e34cce1ba0.png[/img][/url]
Blocking allows you to convert all damage taken to stamina damage. "Tank" characters are better at blocking and thus will take less stamina damage while blocking. If you block an attack while you have no stamina, you will instead take double damage and be knocked to the ground.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36159923/7a1baf62aadeb6232036c3da4c02dfb6f4c72af5.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36159923/7a1baf62aadeb6232036c3da4c02dfb6f4c72af5.gif[/img][/url]
While dodging rolling your character can't be hurt. The catch is different characters are better and worse at dodge rolling. Essentially the better the character is at blocking the worse they are at rolling.

[b]Item System Overhaul[/b]
I have also been working on overhauling the item system. Mainly how the player inventory is being handled. The first thing you may notice is how big the inventory is now! As mentioned in the last development post, I wanted to change the gameplay loop of the game to more of a dungeon diver where players go in and try to escape and survive dungeons with as much loot as they can hold. This new inventory system is the first step towards that vision. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36159923/bcd45b5689bd4c583a4de73e535f3d6fbf4e3410.png[/img]
The main things that are changing is how item are placed into the inventory. Before, it would be 1 item per slot. Now items have different shapes and you have to manage them when placing them into your inventory. It's still a work in progress at this point so I am still ironing out this system, but essentially I want people to eventually have to think about what they pick up while exploring dungeons. Currently you can click, drag and rotate items to hearts content to try to optimize your inventory! Going back to how big the inventory is, this is intentional. I plan on allowing you to prepare and add items to your pack as before you enter dungeons. Things like healing potions, bags for gold, and food all all considerations I want players to prep for before entering dungeon. I am still working this part out so hopefully I'll have updates on that when it's done.

Those are the 2 major things I am working on at the moment. Let me know what you think and any feedback is greatly appreciated. These changes will make it into the updated demo, which I hope is coming soon, hopefully in the next few weeks.

notes.title: Future of the Game and Development 8-12-2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone, it's been a very long time and probably most of you guys have probably left thinking that this is a dead project. You would have been right, up until a month ago. 

First and foremost, I would like to apologize for leaving news about the development of this game up in the air for this long. Things came up which made working on this game hard, and thus the halting of development up until this point.  So this message is an update on what is going on with development moving forward.

In short, I have started development of the game once more, with a few game play and system changes to better help me finish the game. In summary I am looking to:

1. Trim some of the RPG game systems, like the Arcana Card system and talents. These essentially created a lot of overhead when developing new content, so moving forward in newer versions these systems will not be included or the focus. (These systems might come back later on)
2. Removing the companion AI system. This ended up being a little too difficult for me to get up and running properly. This is being replaced with a player party system in which you get to play the characters that used to be companions.
3. Moving away from a story focus. Before this game was mixing the traditional JRPG story with procedural generation. While this was an interesting idea, this ended up being a sort of failure in my eyes since it was hard to tell a good story and have it change every time you played. Essentially I don't think my storytelling was good enough >.< Therefore moving forward I will be leaning more into the procedural generation part with a lighter story focus. What this will mean will be less story dialogue overall and a greater focusing in game play.

Sounds like I'm cutting a lot of things, huh? Yup you're right, but I've determined this is necessary in order to reduce the scope of the project to a point where a solo developer like me can get it done. 

So next I wanted to quickly talk about my vision of the game's design moving forward. As of right now I wanted to simplify the game play into 4 main themes/mechanics: 

Explore -> Survive -> Loot -> Upgrade -> Repeat. 

Simply put, the core of the game will be [b]Exploring [/b] procedurally generated dungeons. In those dungeons you will find [b]Loot[/b] that you can use you [b]Upgrade[/b] your characters while trying to [b]Survive[/b] as long as you can. While I am still tinkering with some of the details with this new design direction, I want to say that the current action RPG gameplay base (Like Secret of Mana or Zelda) will remain.

This has become a long post, and I hope I got across most of my thoughts. If you made it this far, thank you for reading. This is a drastic change, so I understand if people have feedback, and I would love to hear it! I would like to end this news post to say what you can expect in the near term. While the actually game will remain in its current old version I will be releasing an updated demo with all the new systems mentioned above in place, and would love feedback when it's released. After the updated demo, I will work towards updating the rest of the game with the new systems as well as updating the store page to reflect the new features. Thank you again for reading.

notes.title: Development Update 1/31/21
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I am here again for another development update. This one is going to be a little short, since I am still working on the stuff outlined in the last update. I can however give an update and possible time scale for finishing.

The main thing I worked on since last time was polishing the higher tier bust spells. In doing so I also uncovered some major bugs, which should be fixed. I really enjoyed working on them, and they really do have more cinematic flare. These changes should be done by this week.

Moving forward, the final level polish will probably take around a month to do, so you can probably expect the full release patch finishing the game and fixing aforementioned bugs in March. (Let's hope!)

I should be able to include the changes to some of the unique items as well by then as well.

As mentioned before, things like additional companions and better translations will occur after the full release patch based on the community.

Thanks for reading, and I hope to give some more updates soon!

notes.title: Development Update 1/10/21
notes.content:
Hello everyone, sorry for the delay in updates, the end of the year and holiday season has been a busy time. But now that we are past that I can begin to work on the game more regularly. Let's get right into it. Other than some residual bugs, there are a few things I want to focus on that are blocking full release of the game.

1. [b]Final Level[/b] 
The first is the final level. As of right now, the final level is about 40-50% done. The rooms have all been laid out and the final quests for the final level have been completed as well. What remains are a few things which I will list below:

-Polishing the final boss. The final boss is partially complete mechanics wise. I have been thinking about raising the difficulty a bit more as well as add some more phases and mechanics to make it feel like a final boss. This is the bulk of what remains.

-Minor visual bugs. The final level has a lot of set pieces that can obscure players and enemies. I've noticed that there are some issues with displaying those enemies or player so I would like to fix these too.

-Fixing up enemy behaviors. All of the enemies that will exist on this level are implemented and added. They all have their basic attack patterns done, but I would like to revisit them since I am not happy with a few of them.

2. [b]Polishing the end game skills and items[/b]
Other than the last level, the most powerful spells in the game, I believe, need a rework. Damage wise and visually they are lacking for what a player must put in to earn them. I will be also adjusting some more of the spells and burst spells to make them work better with controller. I also feel that a few of the legendary items could use some love as well. Currently the unique legendries that drop from bosses are just better stats than normal. I would like to also possible add interesting effects to them as well.

That's what I have on my radar. Again thanks to everyone still sticking with me. Hopefully I can get the last level done in about a months time! As always comments and suggestions are always welcome and I'll keep you guys updated!

notes.title: Development Log 12/6/20
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is the 2nd development log for my game and for this one I'd like to update you guys on the progress of the stuff I mentioned next week. 

1. [b]Steam Achievements[/b]
I am happy to say that steam achievements are pretty much good and ready to go. It will be launching with 28 achievements. Though a few will only be unobtainable until later patches. 

2. [b]Controller Support[/b]
Glad to say this one is also pretty much good to go. There are still a few loose ends for this feature, but overall the game should work with most controllers now. For now I will say this is about 80% done, and should be done in the next week. I will be updating the in game control page to reflect the new proper controller bindings.

3. [b]Expediting the gameplay.[/b]
To start off, I'm giving the option for players starting a new game to skip the tutorial level. In addition to this, any previously watched cutscene will be skipped on subsequent playthroughs to help speed up gameplay.

4. [b]Game Saves[/b]
This is still in progress. There are still a few existing bugs that I still need to sort out for this one. This one is pretty much blocking a new game patch. This will be the main focus of the remaining week.

Overall, I think there is good progress on the features and you can probably expect a new patch including the above mentioned features around next week.

Moving forward I am going to focus all my efforts on finishing up the final level. This will be the main focus for the next few weeks after this current patch is finished.

In addition to other features and the back burner mentioned in the last log, I am also thinking about allowing players to bind their controls.

notes.title: Development Update 11/23/20
notes.content:
Hello everyone, first and foremost I would like to thank everyone that has supported this game. (Even though it's still buggy) I am writing this post to tell you guys what you guys can expect moving forward. I plan do do these updates on a biweekly basis and will highlight some key things that I am working on to bring this game closer to full release.

Here's what I have been working on:

1. [b]Game Saves[/b]
As it turns out making a save system is a lot harder than I thought it was, and I could have (and probably should have) done a lot more organizing while making it. As of now I am still catching bugs and am working to fix this, which includes the actually data not saving, freezing in save menus and failure to load games. I estimate this issue will take some time to fix so please bear with me. :/

2. [b]Steam Achievements[/b]
You may notice now that there are now steam achievements listed on the game! I have added a total of 28 achievements and am now in the process of testing to see if they work. This first batch should be finished soon and unlockable in game in, maybe, 1-2 weeks.

3. [b]Controller Support[/b]
This issue is also in the works. Currently you are able to play some of the game with controller, but there are many issues with it currently which can cause your game to freeze or even crash. I am in the process of fixing this, and will try to get my fixes out as soon as possible (but there are a lot of things I need to fix currently). This issue will probably take at least 2 weeks to fully fix. So if you use controller, beware of bugs!

4. [b]Expediting the gameplay.[/b]
This is really for making your life easier. After seeing a cutscene once you probably don't want to see it again when doing another run. I also want to add an option to skip the opening story sequences so players can get to the dungeon crawling earlier, this latter fix will be coming very soon, probably within the week.

These are currently on the backburner and will get picked up after the before issues are resolved.

1. [b]Level 5[/b]
This is the final level of the game, and hopefully the climax.

2. [b]The 3rd Player Companion[/b]

3. [b]Possibly proper localization to other languages.[/b]
Sorry about the poorly translated languages!

4. [b]Other Game-breaking bugs[/b]
I'm sure there's still broken stuff that I don't know  about that will need a fix in the future.

notes.title: Early Access Ver 1.0 Release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36159923/9b5e38b6dfabbc1283c4b9f777a8f0e47b59abe2.png[/img]

Hey everyone thanks for all the support and feedback during the festival event! I've been hard at work fixing (trying at least) the bugs brought up during the event, and I think the game is in a state where there is enough content to start giving you guys some gameplay and would like to start receiving feedback. Making this game has been a hobby for me, and I would love to make it an experience you guys want to play, so please give me feedback.

[b]
I wanted to write this post to tell you specifically what you are getting if you buy this game in the state it is in now.[/b]

1. First and foremost there will still be some bugs still in the game, though I believe that most of the game-breaking bugs have been fixed. If you find one please let me know and I'll try to fix it asap!

2. The game does not have all the planned levels in it yet, as well as a bit of content. Currently with this release, 4/5 of the planned dungeons are in the game. I felt that the last level, while in working order, is not up to release quality just yet and would like to continue refining it since it is the supposed climatic part of the game. Additionally, one of the companions you can pick is not in yet either.

3. You may notice some controller prompts or icons though out the game, and for the most part they may work... However for this early access release I am not supporting controller. There was just a lot more work I believe that needed to be done to get it completely working and I didn't have the time for this release. I will be adding it later though, and partial controller support will be included on the game's full release.

4. The game's localization, while there, is google translated for every language except English at the moment. I do not plan on doing more formal localization unless there are enough players wanting their language properly translated.

5. You may see some steam achievements listed and are wondering how to earn them. There is currently no way to unlock them in this version of the game and will be added in the future.

6. I am only releasing on windows for now. iOS will be added in a later patch.

I think that's all I've got to say. Anyways look forward to hearing from you guys. Let's make this game great! :)
